health.notesTitle: How this is collected, and what's left out
notes: Uses only what .NET 9 already provides (Process, GC.GetGCMemoryInfo, ThreadPool, MeterListener) — no extra agent or package
A high queue with low CPU means threads are blocked waiting on I/O (usually the database) — the classic "the system hangs but the machine looks idle" pattern
Machine memory comes from the GC; CPU is this process only, not the whole machine (other programs included) — that needs the server's own monitoring
Does not yet include the DB connection pool or anything on the SQL Server side (CPU, waits, blocking)

guide.title: Search guide
guide.subtitle: Click any highlighted example to search it right away · patterns can be combined in one box
tips: Press Enter or "Search" — the app never searches while you type
A pattern marked "scans the range" reads every row in the selected window — 24h is roughly 30x faster than 30 days
A pattern marked "very fast" uses an index, so even 30 days stays quick
Query (read) logs are not stored, except when they fail or take over 3 seconds

rows.word: Type one or several words — several words must all be present
rows.phrase: Matches the exact phrase — use it when the term has spaces or punctuation
rows.negate: Excludes rows containing this — use it to drop results you know aren't relevant
rows.guid: No need to know which ID it is — searches Correlation, Appraisal, Request, Workflow, Collateral and Document IDs at once
rows.appraisal: Accepts either a GUID or an appraisal number
rows.request: Doesn't work on rows written before this change shipped — the old column stored the wrong value
rows.corr: Every log of the same HTTP request, start to finish — this value is also returned in the X-Correlation-Id header to external systems
rows.user: A user name, or an external system's client id, e.g. los
rows.path: The URL that was called — matches anywhere in the path
rows.source: Any part of the class name that wrote the log
rows.level: Information, Warning, Error, Fatal (or click a level chip above)

recipes.losFailed: An external system called in and it failed
recipes.http400: Inbound API calls that returned 400 (incomplete data)
recipes.commandFailed: Commands that failed, with the payload that was sent
recipes.losDeliveryFailed: Events to LOS that failed to deliver

emptyState: No log entries in this range — try widening the range or clearing a filter
